comparison.objective: Close and engage a snap-fit case lid; the candidate locks a gripper setting with a jam nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a lid and apply distributed force until compliant snaps engage, not wrench/driver countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Required snap features must engage and case remain closed/released; candidate verifies angle retention through motion.
comparison.reason: Snap-fit engagement is a different locking mechanism in both versions.
